scope: Post-result validation-only readjudication of the completed v242 formal and independent runs. Every Case 7 observation, geometry, cache state, solver field, residual, exact-call ledger, metric, accuracy threshold, arm, control, and summary remains immutable. The readjudication addresses only the single camera-permutation metric-level numerical assertion that made the otherwise exact formal/independent result inconclusive.
ordering_evidence: This protocol is committed after the sealed v242 inconclusive result but before any v242.1 field-relative, restored-residual-relative, permutation metric replay, or permutation gate-identity value is computed. Git ancestry, the complete sealed result-tree inventories, exclusive output, and source closure are authoritative; the timestamp is descriptive only.

defect_hypothesis.single_failed_assertion: Reversing the nine camera blocks changes only floating-point reduction order in the same unchanged PCGLS recurrence. The recorded metric-level maximum exceeded the 1e-8 diagnostic by 2.388770731508458e-9, while formal and independently recomputed original and reversed fields, residuals, metrics, summaries, calls, and cache audits are pairwise byte-identical across implementations.
defect_hypothesis.why_readjudication_is_bounded: The original metric-level threshold remains recorded as failed. v242.1 may recover numerical validity only if the already sealed original and reversed physical predictions satisfy the inherited 1e-8 formal-independent field and residual bounds, a standalone metric replay reproduces the recorded discrepancy, and every scientific cell, complete-rig, matched-accuracy, primary-pass, and control-failure predicate is unchanged under the reversed-camera replay.
defect_hypothesis.why_no_candidate_selection_changes: No solver is rerun and no field, residual, metric, summary, arm, control, depth, initializer, cache update, preconditioner, exact-call ledger, scientific threshold, or dominance rule can be changed. The only permitted output is an audit receipt derived from immutable arrays.

array_contract.permuted_camera_rule: reverse the nine camera blocks; restore a reversed residual to original order by reversing its nine contiguous 512-value blocks

readjudication_rules.required_prior_failure_shape: The formal and first-validation false-check sets must each equal the single frozen camera_permutation_metrics_passed entry, every other original check must be true, and both original decisions must be inconclusive-invalid.
readjudication_rules.tree_immutability: The complete formal and first-validation trees and every upstream payload or parent metric opened for metric replay must remain byte-identical before and after readjudication.
readjudication_rules.formal_independent_identity: Require byte-identical formal and independent fields, residuals, reversed-camera fields, reversed-camera residuals, metrics, calls, residual replay, and cache audit arrays.
readjudication_rules.direct_prediction_checks: Using only sealed arrays, compute the maximum relative L2 difference between each original rig-0 later field and its reversed-camera field. Restore each reversed residual to original camera-block order and compute the corresponding maximum relative L2 difference. Both maxima must be no greater than the already frozen v242 formal-independent 1e-8 field/residual bounds.
readjudication_rules.standalone_metric_replay: With a standalone metric implementation, re-open the already sealed Case 7 density/grid payload only for truth scoring; score every sealed original and reversed-camera rig-0 field/residual, require original replay agreement with sealed metrics within the inherited 1e-8 metric bound, and require the replayed reversed-vs-original metric maximum to reproduce the already recorded 1.2388770731508458e-8 within 1e-12 absolute. No operator or solver call is permitted.
readjudication_rules.scientific_gate_identity: Replace only rig 0 with the replayed reversed-camera metrics, independently recompute all unchanged strict-cell, complete-rig p90-higher/worst, matched-accuracy, primary, control, and dominance predicates, and require every arm pass/fail and final decision to equal the sealed original result. Primary must pass and all four equal-or-cheaper controls must fail in both orderings.
readjudication_rules.decision_order: Any seal, source, prior-failure-shape, array identity, physical field/residual, metric replay, scientific-gate, call-ledger, summary, or tree-immutability failure keeps v242 inconclusive. Only a complete pass may recover the original warm-specific current-condition headroom decision.

output_contract.interpretation: A pass establishes only deterministic warm-specific strict exact-call headroom on the already opened Case 7 proxy condition: the actual K14 warm arm passes while four equal-or-cheaper classical controls fail. It does not establish learning, wall/RSS benefit, prospective external generalization, curved rays, real BOST, paper success, or an algorithm breakthrough.
